acceptance: The current Pi registration, package, launcher-loading, exact-version, dependency, trust/approval, and evidence-validator boundaries are inventoried with authoritative sources and consumers.
The smallest future Pi adapter boundary is explicit and host-specific; task-control, process mechanics, execution-contract vocabulary, emitted-path safety, and completion authority remain outside it.

Provider-free fixture requirements cover supported loading, exact version mismatch/unavailability, registration failure and unsupported service versions, trust/approval behavior, package self-containment assumptions, rollback, and emitted-path privacy without adding implementation.
Compatibility and recovery preserve the static .pi adapter and current package path until replacement evidence passes; no speculative directory or package split is authorized.
Task-record, backlog, JSON, content/navigation, whitespace, diagnostics, and final expert validation pass.
